units.title: 道业总纲：孔孟之道五伦为体、经世为用，困亨夷险各尽其道无须筮；弃家入道、拔俗修真、爱网难除、至人难遇，然道有道缘业有业障亦常于筮而得之（割爱离尘何用筮？所处安危、择师邪正亦赖圣贤告我）；本章七问：择师传法、主持纲纪、募缘法会、斋戒

rule.yi: 孔孟之道，以五伦为体、以经世为用；困与亨、夷与险，各有各的尽道之法，何必占筮。如果是弃家入道、超拔流俗、修行求真，爱欲的网难除，得道的人难遇，这自然是大丈夫的事，哪里同于世俗人的占筮？然而道有道缘，业有业障，也常常靠占筮得知。割断爱欲、离开尘世，一念之间就是万年，哪里用得着占筮？然而所处的安危、择师的邪正，也仍要靠圣贤告诉我。本章分七问：择师、传法、主持、纲纪、募缘、法会、斋戒。
rule.en: The Way of Confucius and Mencius takes the five human relations as its body and ordering the world as its use; in hardship and success, ease and danger, each has its own way of exhausting what is right, and why should one divine? But for one who leaves home to enter the Way, rises above the common run and practises to find the truth, the net of love is hard to cut, and a perfected man is hard to meet; this is of course the affair of a great man, and how could it be the same as the divining of the ordinary world? Yet the Way has its affinity for the Way, and the vocation has its karmic obstruction, and these too can often be learned by divining. Cutting off love and leaving the dust, one thought is ten thousand years, and what use is divining? Yet the safety or danger of where one lives, and whether the teacher one chooses is straight or crooked, one still relies on the sages to tell me. The chapter takes seven questions: choosing a teacher, transmitting the teaching, being abbot, being in the administration, soliciting donations, ritual assemblies and fasting.

zh: 孔孟之道，以五伦为体，以经世为用，
困亨夷险，有各尽之道，何以筮为。
若弃家入道，拔俗修真，爱网难除，
至人难遇，自是大丈夫事，岂同流俗人之筮？
然道有道缘，业有业障，亦常于筮而得之。
yi: 孔孟之道，以五伦为体，以经世为用；
困与亨、夷与险，各有各的尽道之法，何必占筮。
如果是弃家入道，超拔流俗、修行求真，爱欲的网难除，
得道的人难遇，这自然是大丈夫的事，哪里同于世俗人的占筮？
然而道有道缘，业有业障，也常常靠占筮得知。
en: The Way of Confucius and Mencius takes the five human relations as its body and ordering the world as its use;
in hardship and success, ease and danger, each has its own way of exhausting what is right, and why should one divine?
But for one who leaves home to enter the Way, rises above the common run and practises to find the truth, the net of love is hard to cut,
and a perfected man is hard to meet; this is of course the affair of a great man, and how could it be the same as the divining of the ordinary world?
Yet the Way has its affinity for the Way, and the vocation has its karmic obstruction, and these too can often be learned by divining.

zh: 割爱离尘，一念万年，何用筮耶？
然所处安危，择师邪正，亦赖圣贤告我。
yi: 割断爱欲、离开尘世，一念之间就是万年，哪里用得着占筮？
然而所处的安危，择师的邪正，也仍要靠圣贤告诉我。
en: Cutting off love and leaving the dust, one thought is ten thousand years, and what use is divining?
Yet the safety or danger of where one lives, and whether the teacher one chooses is straight or crooked, one still relies on the sages to tell me.

zh: 内详择师传法、主持纲纪、募缘法会、斋戒七问
yi: 里面详述择师传法、主持纲纪、募缘法会、斋戒七问。
en: Within are treated in detail seven questions: choosing a teacher and transmitting the teaching, being abbot and in the administration, soliciting donations and ritual assemblies, and fasting.

note.yi: 「五伦」是君臣、父子、夫妇、兄弟、朋友。「经世」是治理世事。「至人」是修养到极处的人，「拔俗修真」是超脱流俗、修行求真。「爱网」是情爱的牵缠。「道缘」是和道的缘分，「业障」是前世所造的业带来的障碍。书里自注：割爱离尘的人，一念就是万年，用不着占；但所处的安危、选师的邪正，还要靠占告诉我。这一章讲的是出家修行的人（佛、道两家）的职业和处境，按职业归入事业；和世俗官职不同的是，它的用神多取世爻和福神。章首列的七问是择师、传法、主持、纲纪、募缘、法会、斋戒。
note.en: The 'five relations' are ruler and minister, father and son, husband and wife, elder and younger brother, and friend. 'Jingshi' is managing worldly affairs. A 'perfected man' is one cultivated to the utmost, and 'rising above the common run and practising to find the truth' is escaping the vulgar and cultivating the truth. The 'net of love' is the entanglement of affection. 'Affinity for the Way' is the karmic affinity with the Way, and 'karmic obstruction' is the hindrance brought by karma made in earlier lives. The book's own note: for one who has cut off love and left the dust, one thought is ten thousand years and there is no need to divine; but the safety of where one lives and whether the teacher chosen is straight or crooked still have to be told by divination. This chapter deals with the occupation and circumstances of those who have left home to practise (Buddhist and Daoist), and is placed under Career by occupation; unlike the worldly office, its Subject is mostly the Self line and the fortune spirit. The seven questions listed at the head of the chapter are choosing a teacher, transmitting the teaching, being abbot, being in the administration, soliciting donations, ritual assemblies and fasting.

units.title: 道业·道缘与业缘：道缘福神、业缘系爻；子孙持世道成、官鬼交重障重；世不可病——病于破则多疾多灾修落傍门、病于散绝则自暴自弃心慵半路、随墓助伤则身陷泥犁、世生世旺则心开日月之光；专忌鬼动及世爻破散绝为三戒、世动亦主不宁

rule.yi: 什么叫道缘？福神就是。什么叫业缘？系爻就是。所以子孙持世，道就成；官鬼交重，障就重。而世不可有病：病在破，多病多灾，修行落入傍门；病在散、绝，自暴自弃，半路上心里懒散；随墓、助伤，则身陷泥犁（地狱）之地；世被生、世旺，则心里打开日月的光明。这是它的大象。专忌鬼动，以及世爻破、散、绝，这是三戒；世动也主不安宁。
rule.en: What is called the affinity for the Way? The fortune spirit, Output, is it. What is called karmic affinity? The binding line is it. So with Output on the Self the Way is accomplished; with Pressure moving and doubled the obstruction is heavy. And the Self must not be sick: sick by being broken, there are many illnesses and calamities and the practice falls into side paths; sick by being scattered or extinct, one gives oneself up and the heart goes slack halfway; following into the tomb and helping the injury, the body sinks into the pit of hell; with the Self generated and thriving, the heart opens to the light of sun and moon. This is its great image. Moving Pressure is above all feared, and the Self line broken, scattered or extinct, are the three warnings; the Self moving also means unrest.

zh: 何名道缘，福神是也。
何名业缘，系爻是也，
故子孙持世而道成，官鬼交重而障重。
而世不可病也，病于破，多疾多灾，修落傍门；
病于散绝，自暴自弃，心慵半路；
随墓助伤，则身陷泥犁之地。
世生世旺，则心开日月之光，此其大象也。
yi: 什么叫道缘？福神就是。
什么叫业缘？系爻就是，
所以子孙持世，道就成；官鬼交重，障就重。
而世不可有病：病在破，多病多灾，修行落入傍门；
病在散、绝，自暴自弃，半路上心里懒散；
随墓、助伤，则身陷泥犁之地；
世被生、世旺，则心里打开日月的光明，这是它的大象。
en: What is called the affinity for the Way? The fortune spirit, Output, is it.
What is called karmic affinity? The binding line is it,
so with Output on the Self the Way is accomplished; with Pressure moving and doubled the obstruction is heavy.
And the Self must not be sick: sick by being broken, there are many illnesses and calamities and the practice falls into side paths;
sick by being scattered or extinct, one gives oneself up and the heart goes slack halfway;
following into the tomb and helping the injury, the body sinks into the pit of hell;
with the Self generated and thriving, the heart opens to the light of sun and moon; this is its great image.

zh: 专忌鬼动，
及世爻破、散、绝为三戒，
世动亦主不宁。
yi: 专忌鬼动，
以及世爻破、散、绝，这是三戒；
世动也主不安宁。
en: Moving Pressure is above all feared,
and the Self line broken, scattered or extinct, are the three warnings;
the Self moving also means unrest.

note.yi: 「道缘」是修道的缘分，取福神（子孙）；「业缘」是业力的牵缠，取系爻（捆住人的爻，按下文是官鬼）；「障」是业障。「傍门」是旁门左道，「泥犁」是地狱（梵语 niraya），「日月之光」是智慧的光明。「病于破」「病于散绝」是世爻破、散、绝三种伤，各有各的后果：破是身体多灾，散绝是意志消沉。书里自注：专忌鬼动，以及世爻破、散、绝，是三戒；世动也主不宁。这一条是整章的总纲：道成与否看福神和世爻，障碍看官鬼，所以后面各问都先看世、福、鬼。
note.en: 'Daoyuan' is the affinity for cultivating the Way, taken from the fortune spirit (Output); 'yeyuan' is the entanglement of karmic force, taken from the binding line (the line that binds a man, which by the text below is Pressure); 'zhang' is karmic obstruction. 'Pangmen' is a side door, a heterodox way, 'niri' is hell (Sanskrit niraya), and 'the light of sun and moon' is the light of wisdom. 'Sick by being broken' and 'sick by being scattered or extinct' are three kinds of injury to the Self line, each with its consequence: broken means a body with many calamities, scattered or extinct means a sunken will. The book's own note: moving Pressure above all, and the Self line broken, scattered or extinct, are the three warnings; the Self moving also means unrest. This entry is the general principle of the whole chapter: whether the Way is accomplished is seen by the fortune spirit and the Self line, and obstruction by Pressure, so every later question first looks at the Self, Output and Pressure.

units.title: 道业·世空三冲的喜恶：出家而三冲世空为超然物外如孤鹤横空、求道而三冲世空为尘务撄心如困鱼失水；卜出世三冲解网世空无挂碍、卜入道则空无成

rule.yi: 然而世空有喜与恶的分别，三冲有宜与忌的分别：出家而三冲、世空，是超然物外，像孤鹤横空；求道而三冲、世空，是尘世杂务缠心，像困鱼失水。占出世，三冲是解开（俗世的）网，世空是没有牵挂；若占入道，那么空就成不了。
rule.en: Yet the Self Void has a distinction of welcome and unwelcome, and the three clashes a distinction of suitable and unsuitable: for one leaving home, the three clashes and the Self Void are being detached from the world, like a lone crane crossing the sky; for one seeking the Way, the three clashes and the Self Void are worldly business tangling the heart, like a trapped fish out of water. In divining about leaving the world, the three clashes are undoing the net and the Self Void is having nothing hanging on one's mind; if one divines about entering the Way, then Void means it does not come off.

zh: 然世空有喜恶之辨也，三冲有宜忌之分也，
出家而三冲世空，为超然物外，如孤鹤横空。
求道而三冲世空为尘务撄心，如困鱼失水。
yi: 然而世空有喜与恶的分别，三冲有宜与忌的分别：
出家而三冲、世空，是超然物外，像孤鹤横空；
求道而三冲、世空，是尘世杂务缠心，像困鱼失水。
en: Yet the Self Void has a distinction of welcome and unwelcome, and the three clashes a distinction of suitable and unsuitable:
for one leaving home, the three clashes and the Self Void are being detached from the world, like a lone crane crossing the sky;
for one seeking the Way, the three clashes and the Self Void are worldly business tangling the heart, like a trapped fish out of water.

zh: 卜出世，
三冲谓解网，世空谓无挂碍，
若卜入道，则空无成也。
yi: 占卜出世（出家），
三冲是解开（俗世的）网，世空是没有牵挂；
若占入道，那么空就成不了。
en: In divining about leaving the world,
the three clashes are undoing the net, and the Self Void is having nothing hanging on one's mind;
if one divines about entering the Way, then Void means it does not come off.

note.yi: 「三冲」（见 YM.07 注）是冲散、断开；对出家（离开俗世）的人，冲散俗缘是好事，所以宜；对要修行的人（还在俗世里求道），冲散会把修行也断掉，所以忌。「世空」同样：离俗的人世空是无牵无挂，求道的人世空是心里空了、无从落脚。「撄心」是扰乱心神。「出世」是出家离俗，「入道」是进入修行。书里自注把这两种问法分开：卜出世，三冲是解网，世空是无挂碍；卜入道，空就无成。同一个卦象，问的是『出去』还是『进来』，喜恶相反。
note.en: The 'three clashes' (see the note to YM.07) are scattering and cutting apart; for one leaving the world (leaving the secular), scattering the worldly ties is a good thing and so suitable; for one who is to practise (still seeking the Way in the world), scattering will cut off the practice too and so is unsuitable. The 'Self Void' is the same: for one leaving the secular it is having nothing hanging on one's mind, and for one seeking the Way it is the heart gone empty with nowhere to rest. 'Yingxin' is disturbing the mind. 'Chushi' is leaving home and the secular, and 'rudao' is entering practice. The book's own note keeps the two ways of asking apart: divining about leaving the world, the three clashes are undoing the net and the Self Void is having nothing on one's mind; divining about entering the Way, Void means it does not come off. For the same image, whether one asks about 'going out' or 'coming in', welcome and unwelcome are opposite.

units.title: 道业·何年道成与何地法隆：世临日月之期道成、世临生合之地法隆；乱动非清修之象、游魂无戒定之心（道业成身专凭世位，世病乱动游魂俱忌）

rule.yi: 哪一年道成？世临日、月的时期。哪个地方法事兴隆？世临生合的地方。卦象乱动，不是清修之象；游魂，没有戒定（守戒、入定）的心。道业成就自身，专凭世的位置；世病、乱动、游魂，都忌。
rule.en: In which year is the Way accomplished? In the period when the Self is on the Day or the Month. In which place does the teaching flourish? In the place where the Self meets generation and combination. A hexagram of disorderly movement is not the image of pure practice; Wandering Soul has no heart of precepts and meditation. The monastic vocation making the man depends wholly on the position of the Self; a sick Self, disorderly movement and Wandering Soul are all feared.

zh: 何年道成，世临日月之期。
何地法隆，世临生合之地，
乱动非清修之象，游魂无戒定之心。
yi: 哪一年道成？世临日、月的时期。
哪个地方法事兴隆？世临生合的地方。
卦象乱动，不是清修之象；游魂，没有戒定的心。
en: In which year is the Way accomplished? In the period when the Self is on the Day or the Month.
In which place does the teaching flourish? In the place where the Self meets generation and combination.
A hexagram of disorderly movement is not the image of pure practice; Wandering Soul has no heart of precepts and meditation.

zh: 道业成身，专凭世位，
世病、乱动、游魂俱忌。
yi: 道业成就自身，专凭世的位置；
世病、乱动、游魂，都忌。
en: The monastic vocation making the man depends wholly on the position of the Self;
a sick Self, disorderly movement and Wandering Soul are all feared.

note.yi: 「道成」是修道有成，「法隆」是弘法兴盛。「世临日月之期」是世爻所属的地支正逢当年、当月（日、月）的时候；「世临生合之地」是世爻得生、得合的方位。「乱动」是卦里动爻多而乱；「游魂」是游魂卦，主游荡不定。「戒定」是佛家的戒和定（守戒律、入禅定）。书里自注：道业成就一个人，专看世爻的位置，世病、乱动、游魂都是忌。这是本章里讲应期和地点的一条，与 YM.94 的『刻期取证』相配。
note.en: 'Daocheng' is succeeding in cultivating the Way, and 'falong' is the teaching flourishing. 'The Self on the Day or the Month' is the branch of the Self line meeting the branch of the year or the month (day or month); 'the place where the Self meets generation and combination' is the direction where the Self line is generated and combined. 'Disorderly movement' is a hexagram with many moving lines and in disorder; 'Wandering Soul' is a Wandering Soul hexagram, which means drifting without settling. 'Jieding' is the Buddhist precepts and concentration (keeping the rules and entering meditation). The book's own note: the vocation making the man depends wholly on the position of the Self line, and a sick Self, disorderly movement and Wandering Soul are all feared. This entry deals with timing and place in this chapter, and goes with 'fixing a date for realisation' in YM.94.

units.title: 道业·刻期取证、指日还丹：世空无成、六冲多阻、世病则九仞井弃、鬼发则一丈魔高，唯世旺福兴而丹成悟彻（止问求道，世空世病六冲鬼动为四戒）

rule.yi: 限定日期取证（证道）、指日还丹（炼丹成功）：世空就无成，六冲就多阻碍，世病就像掘井九仞而放弃，鬼发就是魔高一丈；只有世旺、福兴，才丹成悟彻。只问求道，世空、世病、六冲、鬼动，这是四戒。
rule.en: For fixing a date for attaining realisation and counting the days to the return of the elixir: the Self Void, and nothing comes of it; a six-clash, and there are many obstructions; a sick Self, and it is digging a well nine fathoms deep and giving it up; Pressure issuing, and the devil stands ten feet high; only with the Self thriving and Output rising is the elixir completed and the realisation thorough. In asking only about seeking the Way, the Self Void, the Self sick, a six-clash and Pressure moving are the four warnings.

zh: 刻期取证，指日还丹，
世空则无成，六冲则多阻，
世病则九仞井弃，鬼发则一丈魔高。
唯世旺福兴，而丹成悟徹。
yi: 限定日期取证，指日还丹，
世空就无成，六冲就多阻碍，
世病就像掘井九仞而放弃，鬼发就是魔高一丈；
只有世旺、福兴，才丹成悟彻。
en: For fixing a date for attaining realisation and counting the days to the return of the elixir,
the Self Void, and nothing comes of it; a six-clash, and there are many obstructions;
a sick Self, and it is digging a well nine fathoms deep and giving it up; Pressure issuing, and the devil stands ten feet high;
only with the Self thriving and Output rising is the elixir completed and the realisation thorough.

zh: 止问求道，
世空、世病、六冲、鬼动为四戒。
yi: 只问求道，
世空、世病、六冲、鬼动，这是四戒。
en: In asking only about seeking the Way,
the Self Void, the Self sick, a six-clash and Pressure moving are the four warnings.

note.yi: 「刻期」是限定日期，「取证」是修行证道（得到证悟），「指日还丹」是指着日子炼成还丹（道家内丹的成功）。「九仞井弃」出自「掘井九仞而不及泉，犹为弃井也」，是功亏一篑；「一丈魔高」是「道高一尺、魔高一丈」，修行越深障碍越大。「丹成悟彻」是丹炼成、悟透彻。书里自注：只问求道的时候，世空、世病、六冲、鬼动是四个要戒的。与 YM.91 的三戒对着看，这里多了一个六冲。
note.en: 'Keqi' is fixing a date, 'quzheng' is attaining realisation in practice, and 'zhiri huandan' is counting the days to the completion of the returned elixir (success in Daoist inner alchemy). 'Digging a well nine fathoms deep and giving it up' comes from 'digging a well nine fathoms and not reaching water is still an abandoned well', failing for want of the last basket of earth; 'the devil stands ten feet high' is 'the Way is a foot high, the devil is ten feet high', the deeper the practice the greater the obstacle. 'Dancheng wuche' is the elixir completed and the realisation thorough. The book's own note: when asking only about seeking the Way, the Self Void, the Self sick, a six-clash and Pressure moving are the four to be warned against. Read against the three warnings of YM.91; here a six-clash is added.

units.title: 道业·择师、受徒传法与云游：择师同延师占——父临日月为名师、世空恐吾不能受教；受徒传法同继嗣——子逢生旺为法器、命墓恐彼不能传持；云游同出行而有访道求利之别

rule.yi: 所以择师，同（延）师占：父临日辰、月建，是名师；世空，恐怕我不能受教。收徒传法，同继嗣占：子逢生旺，是法器（可造之材）；命墓，恐怕他不能传持（继承）。云游同出行占，但有访道和求利的区别，各自兼用相应的象。
rule.en: So choosing a teacher is divined like hiring a teacher: the father line on the Day or Month is a famous teacher; the Self Void, I fear I cannot be taught. Taking disciples and transmitting the teaching is divined like continuing a line of descent: the child line meeting generation and thriving is a vessel of the Dharma (a promising disciple); the life line in the tomb, I fear he cannot carry it on and transmit it. Wandering as a cloud is divined like travelling, but there is a difference between seeking the Way and seeking profit, and each also uses its corresponding image.

zh: 故择师，同师占也，
父临日月为名师，世空恐吾不能受教。
受徒传法，同继嗣也，
子逢生旺为法器，命墓恐彼不能传持。
yi: 所以择师，同（延）师占：
父临日辰、月建，是名师；世空，恐怕我不能受教。
收徒传法，同继嗣占：
子逢生旺，是法器；命墓，恐怕他不能传持。
en: So choosing a teacher is divined like hiring a teacher:
the father line on the Day or Month is a famous teacher; the Self Void, I fear I cannot be taught.
Taking disciples and transmitting the teaching is divined like continuing a line of descent:
the child line meeting generation and thriving is a vessel of the Dharma; the life line in the tomb, I fear he cannot carry it on and transmit it.

zh: 云游同出行，
然有访道求利之别，
各兼用象。
yi: 云游同出行占，
但有访道和求利的区别，
各自兼用相应的象。
en: Wandering as a cloud is divined like travelling,
but there is a difference between seeking the Way and seeking profit,
and each also uses its corresponding image.

note.yi: 「择师」是选老师（同延师占，见本书延师章），「受徒传法」是收徒弟、传授道法（同继嗣，即过继、立嗣），「云游」是僧道四处游方。「名师」是有名的好老师，「法器」是可以承载佛法、承继衣钵的人才。「命墓」是世爻（命）入墓。「传持」是传承并持守。这一条是把道业的几问分别比到世俗已有的占法上去：择师比延师，收徒比继嗣，云游比出行。比到别的占法，就用那一边的断法。
note.en: 'Zeshi' is choosing a teacher (divined like hiring a teacher, see the chapter on hiring a teacher in this book), 'shoutu chuanfa' is taking disciples and handing on the teaching (like continuing a line of descent, that is adoption and establishing an heir), and 'yunyou' is a monk or Daoist wandering from place to place. 'Mingshi' is a famous good teacher, and 'faqi' is a person who can carry the Dharma and inherit the robe and bowl. 'The life line in the tomb' is the Self line (the life) entering the tomb. 'Chuanchi' is handing on and keeping. This entry matches each question of the monastic vocation to a divination already known in the worldly sphere: choosing a teacher to hiring a teacher, taking disciples to continuing a line of descent, wandering to travelling. Once matched to another divination, the judgments of that side are used.

units.title: 道业·住持、纲纪、募缘、法会：应缘倡道多名利之求；住持如占宅（三冲鬼动当退）、纲纪如筮仕（世空官坏无成）、募缘同求财（应空财陷徒往）、法会如设馆（应空鬼动多损）

rule.yi: 此后再往前走，顺应因缘倡导道法，就多有名利的追求了。住持（主持寺观）如占宅：三冲、鬼动，就该退；纲纪（寺观的管事）如筮仕：世空、官坏，就无成；募缘（化缘募捐）同求财：应空、财陷，就白去一趟；法会如设馆：应空、鬼动，就多有损失。
rule.en: Beyond this, to go along with the occasion and promote the Way brings many pursuits of fame and profit. Being abbot (presiding over a temple) is like divining about a house: the three clashes and Pressure moving mean one should withdraw; holding an administrative post is like divining about taking office: the Self Void and Pressure damaged mean nothing comes of it; soliciting donations is the same as seeking wealth: the Other Void and Wealth fallen mean the trip is in vain; a ritual assembly is like opening a school: the Other Void and Pressure moving mean many losses.

zh: 过此以往，应缘倡道，遂多名利之求矣。
住持如占宅也，三冲鬼动而当退。
纲纪如筮仕也，世空官坏而无成。
募缘同求财也，应空财陷而徒往。
法会如设馆也，应空鬼动而多损。
yi: 此后再往前走，顺应因缘倡导道法，就多有名利的追求了。
住持如占宅：三冲、鬼动，就该退；
纲纪如筮仕：世空、官坏，就无成；
募缘同求财：应空、财陷，就白去一趟；
法会如设馆：应空、鬼动，就多有损失。
en: Beyond this, to go along with the occasion and promote the Way brings many pursuits of fame and profit.
Being abbot is like divining about a house: the three clashes and Pressure moving mean one should withdraw;
holding an administrative post is like divining about taking office: the Self Void and Pressure damaged mean nothing comes of it;
soliciting donations is the same as seeking wealth: the Other Void and Wealth fallen mean the trip is in vain;
a ritual assembly is like opening a school: the Other Void and Pressure moving mean many losses.

note.yi: 「应缘倡道」是顺应因缘出来倡导、弘扬道法。「住持」是主持一座寺观，「纲纪」是寺观里管事务和纪律的执事，「募缘」是向信众化缘募捐，「法会」是做法事、办法会。书里把它们分别比到世俗的占法上：住持比占宅（宅卜，见家宅各章），纲纪比筮仕（本章 YM.40 起），募缘比求财，法会比设馆（卜馆章 YM.29 起）。「三冲鬼动而当退」是住持要退位的征兆；「世空官坏而无成」是纲纪的位子谋不成；「应空财陷而徒往」是化缘白跑一趟；「应空鬼动而多损」是法会办起来多有损耗。
note.en: 'Yingyuan changdao' is going along with the occasion to come forward and promote the Way. 'Zhuchi' is presiding over a temple or monastery, 'gangji' is the executive who looks after affairs and discipline in a temple, 'muyuan' is soliciting alms and donations from believers, and 'fahui' is performing rites and holding assemblies. The book matches each to a worldly divination: being abbot to divining about a house (house divination, see the chapters on dwellings), administrative posts to divining about taking office (from YM.40 of this book), soliciting donations to seeking wealth, and the ritual assembly to opening a school (from YM.29, the chapter on a teaching post). 'The three clashes and Pressure moving, one should withdraw' is the sign that an abbot must step down; 'the Self Void and Pressure damaged, nothing comes of it' is that the administrative seat cannot be got; 'the Other Void and Wealth fallen, the trip is in vain' is the begging trip made for nothing; 'the Other Void and Pressure moving, many losses' is the assembly costing much once it is held.

units.title: 道业·持斋戒：专务用神、自占以世为本，用旺鬼静则始终不渝、三冲用坏则半途改辙；若筮开斋破戒当无吉占、世坏鬼动尤凶

rule.yi: 占持斋戒（守斋持戒），专取用神；自己占的以世为本。用旺、鬼静，就始终不变；三冲、用坏，就半路改辙。如果占开斋破戒，不会有吉占；世坏、鬼动尤其凶，只能戒（不要做）罢了。
rule.en: In divining about keeping the fast and the precepts, one attends only to the Subject; in divining for oneself the Self is the base. With the Subject thriving and Pressure still, one does not change from beginning to end; with the three clashes and the Subject damaged, one changes course halfway. If one divines about breaking the fast and the precepts, there will be no auspicious divination; a damaged Self and Pressure moving are especially ominous, and all one can do is refrain.

zh: 筮持斋戒，专务用神，
自占以世为本，用旺鬼静则始终不渝，
三冲用坏，则半途改辙。
yi: 占持斋戒，专取用神；
自己占的以世为本，用旺、鬼静，就始终不变；
三冲、用坏，就半路改辙。
en: In divining about keeping the fast and the precepts, one attends only to the Subject;
in divining for oneself the Self is the base, and with the Subject thriving and Pressure still, one does not change from beginning to end;
with the three clashes and the Subject damaged, one changes course halfway.

zh: 若筮开斋破戒，当无吉占，
世坏鬼动尤凶，戒之而已。
yi: 如果占开斋破戒，不会有吉占；
世坏、鬼动尤其凶，只能戒（不要做）罢了。
en: If one divines about breaking the fast and the precepts, there will be no auspicious divination;
a damaged Self and Pressure moving are especially ominous, and all one can do is refrain.

note.yi: 「斋戒」是素食守斋、持守戒律，「开斋破戒」是中途吃荤、破坏戒律。「专务用神」是专看用神；「自占以世为本」是自己占就以世爻为本位。「始终不渝」是始终不变，「半途改辙」是半路改变做法。书里自注：占开斋破戒，不会有吉占，世坏、鬼动更凶，只能劝戒。这一条的「用神」没有说是哪一爻，按全章的思路是福神（子孙，见 YM.91 道缘）和世爻，按文意理解。
note.en: 'Zhaijie' is keeping a vegetarian fast and keeping the precepts, and 'kaizhai pojie' is breaking the fast and breaking the precepts partway. 'Zhuanwu yongshen' is attending solely to the Subject; 'zizhan yi shi wei ben' is that when divining for oneself the Self line is the base. 'Shizhong buyu' is not changing from beginning to end, and 'bantu gaizhe' is changing one's course halfway. The book's own note: divining about breaking the fast and the precepts there will be no auspicious divination, a damaged Self and Pressure moving are worse, and all one can do is advise refraining. The 'Subject' in this entry is not said to be any particular line; by the thought of the whole chapter it is the fortune spirit (Output, see 'affinity for the Way' in YM.91) and the Self line, taken by the sense.

units.title: 道业·金木释道与卦之升降：西方属金肃杀故释氏像之（乾兑申酉，金爻乾兑之宫福动吉鬼动凶）、东方属木化育故道宗像之（震巽寅卯，木爻震巽之宫官动为恶子动为善）；卦有升降之爻——世居升爻可入圣谓之成、世居降爻不能越凡谓之败，无病则吉有病则凶

rule.yi: 金木，是释（佛）、道；升降，是成败。西方属金，是肃杀之地，所以用释氏来象征它；况且佛从西边来，当属乾、兑、申、酉，所以金爻以及乾、兑之宫，福动就吉，鬼动就凶。东方属木，是化育之所，所以用道宗来象征它；况且道行于东土，当属震、巽、寅、卯，所以木爻以及震、巽之宫，官动是恶，子动是善。卦有升降之爻：如八月得升卦，则世是升爻；八月得泰卦，则世是降爻，这是秋分后四阴升而三阳降的缘由。世居升爻，可以入圣，叫做成；世居降爻，不能超越凡俗，叫做败；然而无病就吉，有病就凶。
rule.en: Metal and Wood are the Buddhists and the Daoists; ascent and descent are success and failure. The west belongs to Metal, a place of austerity and killing, so the Buddhist is imaged by it; and since the Buddha came from the west, it belongs to Qian, Dui, Shen and You, so for a Metal line and the palaces of Qian and Dui, Output moving is auspicious and Pressure moving is ominous. The east belongs to Wood, a place of transformation and nurture, so the Daoist school is imaged by it; and since the Way goes in the eastern land, it belongs to Zhen, Xun, Yin and Mao, so for a Wood line and the palaces of Zhen and Xun, Pressure moving is bad and Output moving is good. A hexagram has lines of ascent and descent: if one gets Sheng in the eighth month, the Self is a line of ascent; if one gets Tai in the eighth month, the Self is a line of descent, which is why after the autumn equinox four yin rise and three yang fall. The Self on an ascending line may enter sagehood, and this is called success; the Self on a descending line cannot rise above the ordinary, and this is called failure; but without sickness it is auspicious, and with sickness ominous.

zh: 夫金木，释道也，
升降，成败也。
yi: 金木，是释（佛）、道；
升降，是成败。
en: Metal and Wood are the Buddhists and the Daoists;
ascent and descent are success and failure.

zh: 西方属金，乃肃杀之地，故以释氏像之，
况自西来，当属乾兑申酉，
所以金爻及乾兑之宫，福动则吉，鬼动则凶。
东方属木，乃化育之所，故以道宗像之，
且行东土，当属震巽寅卯，
故以木爻及震巽之宫，官动为恶，子动为善也。
卦有升降之爻，如八月得升，则世是升爻，
八月得泰，则世是降爻，秋分后四阴升而三阳降之由也。
世居升爻，可以入圣谓之成，
世居降爻，不能越凡谓之败，
然无病则吉，有病则凶。
yi: 西方属金，是肃杀之地，所以用释氏来象征它；
况且佛从西边来，当属乾、兑、申、酉，
所以金爻以及乾、兑之宫，福动就吉，鬼动就凶。
东方属木，是化育之所，所以用道宗来象征它；
况且道行于东土，当属震、巽、寅、卯，
所以木爻以及震、巽之宫，官动是恶，子动是善。
卦有升降之爻：如八月得升卦，则世是升爻；
八月得泰卦，则世是降爻，这是秋分后四阴升而三阳降的缘由。
世居升爻，可以入圣，叫做成；
世居降爻，不能超越凡俗，叫做败；
然而无病就吉，有病就凶。
en: The west belongs to Metal, a place of austerity and killing, so the Buddhist is imaged by it;
and since the Buddha came from the west, it belongs to Qian, Dui, Shen and You,
so for a Metal line and the palaces of Qian and Dui, Output moving is auspicious and Pressure moving is ominous.
The east belongs to Wood, a place of transformation and nurture, so the Daoist school is imaged by it;
and since the Way goes in the eastern land, it belongs to Zhen, Xun, Yin and Mao,
so for a Wood line and the palaces of Zhen and Xun, Pressure moving is bad and Output moving is good.
A hexagram has lines of ascent and descent: if one gets Sheng in the eighth month, the Self is a line of ascent;
if one gets Tai in the eighth month, the Self is a line of descent, which is why after the autumn equinox four yin rise and three yang fall.
The Self on an ascending line may enter sagehood, and this is called success;
the Self on a descending line cannot rise above the ordinary, and this is called failure;
but without sickness it is auspicious, and with sickness ominous.

note.yi: 「释氏」是佛家（释迦牟尼），「道宗」是道家。西方属金、肃杀，象佛；东方属木、化育，象道，是从方位、五行立论，不是评价两家高下。「乾兑申酉」是金的卦宫和地支（乾兑属金，申酉属金），「震巽寅卯」是木的卦宫和地支。「福动则吉，鬼动则凶」「官动为恶，子动为善」是说无论释道，福神（子孙）动都是好、官鬼动都是坏。「卦有升降之爻」按文意是卦里有些爻是升、有些是降：书里举例，八月得升卦，世是升爻；八月得泰卦，世是降爻，理由是『秋分后四阴升而三阳降』（秋分之后阴气渐长，阳气渐消）。世居升爻是向上走（可入圣，叫成），世居降爻是向下走（越不过凡俗，叫败）；但世爻无病才吉，有病仍凶。这里的升降论法比较晦，书里没有展开，按字面译。
note.en: 'Shishi' is the Buddhist school (Sakyamuni) and 'daozong' is the Daoist school. The west belongs to Metal and austerity, which images the Buddha; the east belongs to Wood and nurture, which images the Way: the argument is from direction and phase and is not a judgment of the worth of the two schools. 'Qian, Dui, Shen and You' are the palaces and branches of Metal (Qian and Dui belong to Metal, and Shen and You belong to Metal), and 'Zhen, Xun, Yin and Mao' are the palaces and branches of Wood. 'Output moving is auspicious, Pressure moving is ominous' and 'Pressure moving is bad, Output moving is good' say that in either school Output (the fortune spirit) moving is good and Pressure moving is bad. 'A hexagram has lines of ascent and descent', by the sense, is that some lines in a hexagram ascend and some descend: the book's example is that getting Sheng in the eighth month makes the Self a line of ascent, and getting Tai in the eighth month makes the Self a line of descent, the reason given being that 'after the autumn equinox four yin rise and three yang fall' (after the equinox the yin force grows and the yang force wanes). The Self on an ascending line goes upward (may enter sagehood, called success), and on a descending line goes downward (cannot surpass the ordinary, called failure); but the Self line must be without sickness for it to be auspicious, and with sickness it is still ominous. This account of ascent and descent is rather obscure, the book does not expand on it, and it is translated by the letter.

units.title: 道业·六亲所主：子官善恶、父母摇得典策之誉、兄弟动犯贪嗔之戒、妻财发有萦家之心；子孙动夙有善根福德徒众、官鬼动原有恶孽灾障调达之扰、父母吉动得名誉凶动法嗣聚散、弟兄吉动遇良朋但清苦凶动贪嗔之累、妻财吉动道供盈余凶动妇女缠绊

rule.yi: 子（孙）、官（鬼），是善与恶；父母动，得典籍策书的名誉；兄弟动，犯贪嗔的戒；妻财发，有牵挂家室的心。子孙动，前世就有善根，或者因缘福德深厚，或者有高贤徒众侍奉；官鬼动，原本有恶业，或者灾障缠身，或者调达（提婆达多那样的）搅扰；父母带吉神动，我的书文以后得名誉，带凶神动，主法嗣多聚多散；弟兄吉动，当遇良朋善友，但道风清苦，凶动，常有贪嗔的牵累；妻财吉动，道场供养有盈余，凶动，有妇女缠绊。
rule.en: Output and Pressure are good and evil; Resource moving gains the name of scripture and learning; Peer moving breaks the precept against greed and anger; Wealth issuing brings a heart that clings to home. Output moving means one had roots of goodness from the past, or great karmic merit, or the service of eminent worthies and disciples; Pressure moving means one had evil karma originally, or entanglement by calamity and hindrance, or the harassment of a Devadatta; Resource moving with an auspicious spirit, my writings later win renown, with an ominous spirit, the heirs of the teaching gather and scatter much; Peer moving auspiciously, one will meet good friends but the way of life is austere, ominously, there is often the entanglement of greed and anger; Wealth moving auspiciously, the offerings to the place of practice have a surplus, ominously, women entangle.

zh: 子官，善恶也，
父母摇而得典策之誉，
兄弟动而犯贪嗔之戒，
妻财发而有萦家之心。
yi: 子（孙）、官（鬼），是善与恶；
父母动，得典籍策书的名誉；
兄弟动，犯贪嗔的戒；
妻财发，有牵挂家室的心。
en: Output and Pressure are good and evil;
Resource moving gains the name of scripture and learning;
Peer moving breaks the precept against greed and anger;
Wealth issuing brings a heart that clings to home.

zh: 子孙动，夙有善恨，或因缘福德之隆，或高贤徒众之侍。
官鬼动，原有恶孽，或灾障之缠，或调达之扰。
父母带吉神动，则我书文后得名誉；带凶神动，主法嗣多聚散也。
弟兄吉动，当遇良朋善友，但道风清苦；凶动，常多贪嗔之累。
妻财吉动，道供盈余；凶动，妇女缠绊。
yi: 子孙动，前世就有善根（「善恨」疑为「善根」），或者因缘福德深厚，或者有高贤徒众侍奉；
官鬼动，原本有恶业，或者灾障缠身，或者调达那样的搅扰；
父母带吉神动，我的书文以后得名誉，带凶神动，主法嗣多聚多散；
弟兄吉动，当遇良朋善友，但道风清苦，凶动，常有贪嗔的牵累；
妻财吉动，道场供养有盈余，凶动，有妇女缠绊。
en: Output moving means one had roots of goodness from the past, or great karmic merit, or the service of eminent worthies and disciples;
Pressure moving means one had evil karma originally, or entanglement by calamity and hindrance, or the harassment of a Devadatta;
Resource moving with an auspicious spirit, my writings later win renown, with an ominous spirit, the heirs of the teaching gather and scatter much;
Peer moving auspiciously, one will meet good friends but the way of life is austere, ominously, there is often the entanglement of greed and anger;
Wealth moving auspiciously, the offerings to the place of practice have a surplus, ominously, women entangle.

note.yi: 「子官」是子孙和官鬼，「善恶」是它们代表的善和恶。「典策」是典籍、策书，「父母摇而得典策之誉」是父母爻动、得经书著述的名声。「贪嗔」是佛家说的三毒里的贪和嗔。「萦家」是牵挂家室。注里「夙有善恨」疑是「夙有善根」：前世种下的善根。「因缘福德」是因缘和福报，「高贤徒众」是德高的贤人和众弟子。「恶孽」是恶业，「灾障」是灾难和障碍，「调达」是提婆达多（释迦的堂弟，屡屡破坏僧团的人），泛指搅扰修行的人。「法嗣」是承继道法的弟子，「聚散」是来了又走。「道风」是修道的风气，「清苦」是清贫刻苦。「道供」是道场得到的供养。这一条是把六亲分别配到修道人的处境：子孙是福报，官鬼是业障，父母是名声，兄弟是同道与贪嗔，妻财是供养与家缘。
note.en: 'Zi guan' is Output and Pressure, and 'good and evil' is the good and the evil they stand for. 'Diance' is scriptures and books, and 'Resource moving gains the name of scripture and learning' is that when the Resource line moves one gets the name of writings on the sutras. 'Tanchen' is greed and anger, two of the three poisons of the Buddhists. 'Yingjia' is clinging to home. The 'shan hen' of the note is presumably a slip for 'shan gen', roots of goodness: good roots planted in an earlier life. 'Yinyuan fude' is karmic affinity and the reward of merit, and 'gaoxian tuzhong' is eminent worthies and the host of disciples. 'E'nie' is evil karma, 'zaizhang' is calamity and obstruction, and 'Tiaoda' is Devadatta (the Buddha's cousin, who repeatedly tried to split the order), standing in general for those who disturb the practice. 'Fasi' is a disciple who inherits the teaching, and 'jusan' is coming and then going. 'Daofeng' is the style of the practice, and 'qingku' is poor and hard. 'Daogong' is the offerings the place of practice receives. This entry assigns the six relations to the circumstances of one who practises: Output is the reward of merit, Pressure is karmic hindrance, Resource is fame, Peer is fellow-seekers and greed and anger, and Wealth is offerings and ties to the household.

units.title: 道业·六神所主：螣蛇尘障不除、勾陈夙缘不断、白虎元武灾盗之由、朱雀青龙才名之士，必因鬼动而云凶、福动而云吉（如朱雀摇鬼为是非、动福为名誉）

rule.yi: 螣蛇，是尘世的障碍不除；勾陈，是旧缘不断；白虎、元武，是灾祸盗贼的由头；朱雀、青龙，是有才有名的人；大概必须因鬼动才说凶，福动才说吉。例如朱雀带着摇动的鬼，是是非；朱雀动福，是名誉，之类。
rule.en: The Coiling Snake means the hindrances of the dust of the world are not removed; Hook Earth means old ties are not cut; the White Tiger and the Dark Tortoise are the cause of calamity and theft; the Vermilion Bird and the Azure Dragon are men of talent and name; generally one says ominous only because Pressure moves, and auspicious only because Output moves. For example, the Vermilion Bird with a moving Pressure is disputes; the Vermilion Bird with Output moving is renown, and so on.

zh: 螣蛇尘障不除，勾陈夙缘不断，
白虎元武，灾盗之由，朱雀青龙，才名之士，
盖必因鬼动而云凶，福动而云吉也。
yi: 螣蛇，是尘世的障碍不除；勾陈，是旧缘不断；
白虎、元武，是灾祸盗贼的由头；朱雀、青龙，是有才有名的人；
大概必须因鬼动才说凶，福动才说吉。
en: The Coiling Snake means the hindrances of the dust of the world are not removed; Hook Earth means old ties are not cut;
the White Tiger and the Dark Tortoise are the cause of calamity and theft; the Vermilion Bird and the Azure Dragon are men of talent and name;
generally one says ominous only because Pressure moves, and auspicious only because Output moves.

zh: 如朱雀摇鬼为是非，动福为名誉之类。
yi: 例如朱雀带着摇动的鬼，是是非；朱雀动福，是名誉，之类。
en: For example, the Vermilion Bird with a moving Pressure is disputes; the Vermilion Bird with Output moving is renown, and so on.

note.yi: 「尘障」是尘世的障碍，「夙缘」是前世留下的缘分。「元武」是玄武。「灾盗之由」是灾祸、盗贼的由头，「才名之士」是有才华、有名望的人。「必因鬼动而云凶，福动而云吉」是六神自己的吉凶，要等鬼动或福动才算数：六神只是底色，说凶说吉由动的是鬼还是福来定。书里自注的例子：朱雀带动的鬼是是非口舌，朱雀动福是名誉。六神的本义见术语表，这里是把它们取到修道人的处境上。
note.en: 'Chenzhang' is the hindrances of the dust of the world, and 'suyuan' is the ties left from earlier lives. 'Yuanwu' is the Dark Tortoise. 'The cause of calamity and theft' is the source of calamity and thieves, and 'men of talent and name' are people of talent and reputation. 'One says ominous only because Pressure moves, and auspicious only because Output moves' is that the luck of the six spirits themselves counts only when Pressure or Output moves: the six spirits are only the ground colour, and whether one speaks of ominous or auspicious is fixed by whether it is Pressure or Output that moves. The book's own example: the Vermilion Bird with a moving Pressure is disputes and talk, and the Vermilion Bird with Output moving is renown. The original meanings of the six spirits are in the glossary; here they are taken onto the circumstances of one who practises.

units.title: 道业·修行吉占与圣学：惟得复咸艮无妄而安宁者为修行之吉占；孔孟之学几成功名之捷径、自姚江而后道风渺然，若有豪杰继绝学明圣道亦以此章占；四卦专释心学不拘福鬼冲合直言其吉（安静则然变动复非）；圣学无求道故道业止详二氏三教道同占同

rule.yi: 只有得到复、咸、艮、无妄而安宁的，是修行的吉占。孔孟之学几乎成了功名的捷径，自姚江（王阳明）以后，道风渺茫；如果有豪杰之士起来继承绝学、阐明圣道，也用这一章来占。复、咸、艮、无妄这几个卦，专门解释心学；大抵儒释道三教必以正心为根，占修行得到这几个卦的，不拘福神、鬼、冲合，直接说吉；但安静时才如此，变动了就不是了。圣学没有『求道』一说，所以道业只详述佛道二家；三教之道相同，占法也相同。
rule.en: Only getting Fu, Xian, Gen or Wuwang and being at peace is an auspicious divination for practice. The learning of Confucius and Mencius has almost become a short cut to fame and office, and since Yaojiang (Wang Yangming) the manner of the Way has grown faint; if there are heroic men who rise up to continue the lost learning and make clear the sages' Way, they too divine by this chapter. The hexagrams Fu, Xian, Gen and Wuwang are devoted to the learning of the heart; in general the three teachings all take rectifying the heart as the root, and one who divines about practice and gets these hexagrams, whatever the fortune spirit, Pressure, clash and combination, is simply told that it is auspicious; but this holds only when still, and if moving it is not so again. The sages' learning has no 'seeking the Way', so the monastic vocation treats only the two schools in detail; the three teachings are the same in the Way and the same in divining.

zh: 惟得复咸艮无妄而安宁者，修行之吉占也。
孔孟之学，几成功名之捷径，自姚江而后，
道风妙然，若有豪豪杰之士，起继绝学明圣道，亦以此章占之。
yi: 只有得到复、咸、艮、无妄而安宁的，是修行的吉占。
孔孟之学几乎成了功名的捷径，自姚江以后，
道风渺茫；如果有豪杰之士起来继承绝学、阐明圣道，也用这一章来占。
en: Only getting Fu, Xian, Gen or Wuwang and being at peace is an auspicious divination for practice.
The learning of Confucius and Mencius has almost become a short cut to fame and office, and since Yaojiang,
the manner of the Way has grown faint; if there are heroic men who rise up to continue the lost learning and make clear the sages' Way, they too divine by this chapter.

zh: 四易专释心学，大抵三教必以正心为根，
筮修行得此者，不拘福鬼冲合，直言其吉也，
然安静如之变动复非尔。
圣学无求道者，故道业止详二氏，三教道同占同也。
yi: 这几个卦专门解释心学，大抵三教必以正心为根，
占修行得到这几个卦的，不拘福神、鬼、冲合，直接说吉；
但安静时才如此，变动了就不是了。
圣学没有求道一说，所以道业只详述佛道二家，三教之道相同，占法也相同。
en: These hexagrams are devoted to the learning of the heart; in general the three teachings all take rectifying the heart as the root,
and one who divines about practice and gets these hexagrams, whatever the fortune spirit, Pressure, clash and combination, is simply told that it is auspicious;
but this holds only when still, and if moving it is not so again.
The sages' learning has no 'seeking the Way', so the monastic vocation treats only the two schools in detail; the three teachings are the same in the Way and the same in divining.

note.yi: 「复」「咸」「艮」「无妄」是四个卦名：复是回返本心，咸是感应，艮是止，无妄是不妄动，都有『返回本心、静止』的意思，所以书里说这四卦『专释心学』（「四易」按文意是这四个卦）。「姚江」是王阳明（余姚人，姚江学派），「绝学」是失传的学问，「圣道」是圣人的道。「正心」是端正心思（《大学》语）。「福鬼冲合」是福神、官鬼、冲、合这些平常用的断法，这四卦不拘这些，直接断吉，但只限卦静的时候，变动了就按平常的断法。「圣学无求道者」是儒家圣学里没有『出家求道』这回事，所以这一章只讲佛、道两家；三教（儒释道）之道相同，占法也相同。这一条是道业章的收尾，和章首（YM.90）的『孔孟之道无须筮』前后呼应。
note.en: Fu, Xian, Gen and Wuwang are four hexagram names: Fu is returning to the original heart, Xian is response, Gen is stopping, Wuwang is not acting rashly, all with the sense of 'return to the original heart and be still', so the book says these four are 'devoted to the learning of the heart' ('the four changes' by the sense is these four hexagrams). 'Yaojiang' is Wang Yangming (a man of Yuyao, the Yaojiang school), 'juexue' is learning that has been lost, and 'shengdao' is the sages' Way. 'Zhengxin' is rectifying the heart (a phrase of the Great Learning). 'Fortune spirit, Pressure, clash and combination' are the ordinary methods of judgment; these four hexagrams are not tied to them and are directly called auspicious, but only when the hexagram is still, and if moving the ordinary judgment is used. 'The sages' learning has no seeking the Way' is that in the Confucian sages' learning there is no 'leaving home to seek the Way', so this chapter speaks only of the Buddhist and Daoist schools; the three teachings (Confucian, Buddhist, Daoist) are the same in the Way and the same in divining. This entry closes the chapter and answers the head of the chapter (YM.90), 'the Way of Confucius and Mencius needs no divining'.
